candidates.title: Cloudflare Turnstile captcha on the public Check and Pay search (Vehicle Number and Notice Number tabs)
candidates.related_note: OCMS50.2 (Demo paid) covers searching by vehicle number / notice number without Singpass. Its text says nothing about a captcha or bot check. This adds the captcha widget, the token verification endpoint and the gate on the Search Fines button.
candidates.user_story: As URA, I want a captcha check before a member of the public can search fines by vehicle number or notice number without logging in, so that the search cannot be run by bots in bulk.
acceptance: On the Vehicle Number and Notice Number tabs the Search Fines button stays disabled until the Turnstile widget returns a token
The UI posts the token to turnstile/v1/validate and the API checks it with Cloudflare siteverify
An invalid or missing token returns OCMS-4000 'Token not correct. Please try again.'
The captcha is not shown on the Singpass/ID tab
The validate endpoint is open without JWT so it works before login

evidence.what: isCaptcha is set for tabs 2 and 3 until turnstileCompleted
search blocked when isCaptcha and no turnstileToken
InitCaptcha: sets sitekey, validateEndpoint turnstile/v1/validate, enables continue button on success
renders uds-captcha-turnstile and the Search Fines button only on tabs 2 and 3
turnstile.render of the widget
POST turnstile/v1/validate, calls turnstileService.isTokenValid
isTokenValid posts secret+token to Cloudflare siteverify (secret read at line 49)
/turnstile/ path skips JwtFilter
turnstile.enabled=true (also uat:80, dev:89)

candidates.works_basis: Widget, gate and token check are all in code and enabled in dev/uat/prod properties. But the check only exists in the browser: /v1/parkingfines does not check the token (@RequireTurnstile, RequireTurnstile.java:14, is not used on any controller and the aspect at TurnstileValidationAspect.java:30 therefore never fires), so someone calling the API directly skips it. The real Cloudflare secret lives in Key Vault and cannot be verified from repo.
candidates.ura_requested: no (no flow deck exists in repo)
candidates.points_basis: Estimate. Similar in size to OCMS50.2 (2) plus a backend verification endpoint, so 3, below OCMS50.17 QR code (5). MGG/URA decision.
demo_steps: Open Check and Pay on the UAT eService, go to the Vehicle Number tab
Observe that Search Fines is disabled until the Turnstile widget completes
Complete the widget, enter a vehicle number and search
Switch to the Notice Number tab and repeat
risks: The captcha is a front-end gate only, backend /v1/parkingfines is not protected, so URA may say it does not really stop bots
Not requested in any story or ticket found; OCMS50.2 and OCMS50.7 traces already cite the captcha as part of the search page
May be seen as part of the normal build of the search page (OCMS50.2, Demo paid)

candidates.title: WOGAA transaction tracking for the Pay Parking Offence Notice and Furnish Driver's Particulars e-services
candidates.user_story: As URA, I want each e-service to report its started and completed transactions to the WOGAA platform, so that URA can see usage and completion rates of the Payment and Furnish services.
acceptance: Payment: StartTS('PAYMENT') is called when the user clicks Pay Now
Payment: CompleteTS('PAYMENT') is called when the result page shows, for success and for failure
Furnish: StartTS('FURNISH') is called once per transaction when the user proceeds to Review
Furnish: CompleteTS('FURNISH') is called after submit, for success and for failure
Calls wait up to 5 seconds for the WOGAA script to load, and run only in UAT and PROD builds

evidence.what: StartTS / CompleteTS wrappers around wogaaCustom.startTransactionalService / completeTransactionalService; only when isUAT or isPROD; waits for the script (WOGAA_WAIT_MS=5000)
StartTS('PAYMENT')
CompleteTS('PAYMENT') (second call at :48)
StartTS('FURNISH') once per transaction (wogaaStarted guard at :465)
CompleteTS('FURNISH') after successful submit (failure branch at :198)
WOGAA ids per service and script URL read from env

candidates.works_basis: Call sites exist and are guarded correctly in code. Whether WOGAA actually records the transactions depends on the VITE_WOGAA_* env values and the WOGAA portal, which are outside the repo. Tickets show the Payment completion count looked far too low (7,843 started vs 81 completed in OCMS-SR-2026-186) and Furnish showed 0 (OCMS-DF-2026-191); both are 'Ready to PRD', so the fixes may not be live.
candidates.ura_requested: ticket: OCMS-SR-2026-186 and OCMS-DF-2026-191 (they asked for the tracking to be investigated/fixed; no story asks for it)
candidates.points_basis: Estimate. Small front-end integration, comparable to OCMS42.28 (3) or OCMS50.18 (2). MGG/URA decision.
demo_steps: In UAT, run a full payment up to the result page and a full furnish submission
Check the WOGAA dashboard for service ids parkingura-6270 (Payment) and parkingura-6271 (Furnish) (ids taken from ticket text, not verified in env files)
risks: Both tickets are defects/investigations under maintenance, so URA may treat this as a bug fix and not as new scope
Fix for Furnish is only 'Ready to PRD', not confirmed live
Result in WOGAA portal cannot be proven from the repo

candidates.title: Block furnishing yourself as hirer/driver (validate-id check before Review)
candidates.related_note: OCMS42.22 (Fully paid) covers prompts for an invalid NRIC/FIN and missing mandatory fields. It does not mention refusing an ID that equals the logged-in owner. This adds that rule, a session-based API check and the error message.
candidates.user_story: As URA, I want the furnish page to refuse a hirer/driver ID that is the same as the logged-in owner, so that owners cannot furnish themselves as the hirer.
acceptance: On Proceed to Review, when the hirer/driver ID type is UEN or answer Q1 is N, the UI calls POST v1/furnishapplication/validate-id
The API compares the entered ID with the session owner (UEN for Corppass, NRIC for Singpass), case-insensitive
On a match the ID field shows 'You cannot furnish yourself as the vehicle hirer.' and the user stays on the form
The result is cached in the UI for 30 seconds

evidence.what: shouldCheckSelfFurnish (hdIDType=UEN or hdQ1=N), calls APIValidateFurnishId, sets error and stops
APIValidateFurnishId with 30s cache; returns match=false on any error
self_furnish message text
POST /v1/furnishapplication/validate-id compares furnishIdNo with entityId/userId from the session

candidates.works_basis: Code path is complete from button to API. Weak points: the check only runs when ID type is UEN or Q1=N (not for every NRIC/FIN), the UI treats an API error as 'no match' (fails open), and I did not find the same rule re-checked in the submit endpoint (not fully searched).
candidates.ura_requested: no (no flow deck exists in repo)
candidates.points_basis: Estimate. Same size as OCMS42.22 (2). MGG/URA decision.
demo_steps: Log in to the UAT Furnish service with Singpass
Pick a notice, choose 'hirer/driver is someone else' (Q1=N) and enter your own NRIC as the hirer/driver ID
Click Proceed to Review and see the error message
risks: Condition is narrow (UEN or Q1=N), so URA may call it a validation detail inside OCMS42.22/42.23
Message text is also in HDQuests.ts:317, which suggests the rule was partly intended in other stories (not checked)

candidates.title: Acknowledgement email to the owner after a furnish submission
candidates.related_note: OCMS42.28 (Fully paid) covers the on-screen acknowledgement page with a PDF summary. The OCMS42.26 trace also notes the email but no story text asks for it. This adds a consolidated email with transaction numbers and notice list, sent from a database template with retry.
candidates.user_story: As a vehicle owner who has furnished hirer/driver particulars, I want to receive an email acknowledging my submission with the transaction numbers and notice numbers, so that I have a record outside the web page.
acceptance: After a successful submit the API sends one email for all notices in the submission to the owner email, if filled in
The subject contains the transaction numbers and the body lists the notice numbers
Subject and body come from the template furnish_acknowledgement_email.html in the database
The send is asynchronous and retried up to 3 times (2s initial delay, max 30s) on mail errors
Nothing is sent when the owner email is empty

evidence.what: sendFurnishAcknowledgementEmail called after submitFurnishApplication
@Async + @Retryable method; skips when email empty; fills template; setTo at ~160, mailSender.send at :169
template name furnish_acknowledgement_email.html
email.retry.maxAttempts=3, initialDelayMs=2000, maxDelayMs=30000
spring.mail.host=urasmtp.uraaz.gov.sg
UI sends ownerEmailAddr from the form

candidates.works_basis: Code is complete and has no feature flag. Whether the mail is delivered depends on the SMTP relay and on the template row existing in the database, neither of which is in the repo. Failures are only logged, not shown to the user.
candidates.ura_requested: no (no flow deck exists in repo)
candidates.points_basis: Estimate. Similar to OCMS42.28 (3); smaller than OCMS41.16 email/SMS templates (5). MGG/URA decision.
demo_steps: In UAT submit a furnish application with an owner email filled in
Check the inbox of that email for the acknowledgement with the txn numbers (needs a mailbox reviewer can read)
risks: The OCMS42.26 trace already mentions this email as supporting evidence of a Fully paid story
Email field on the form is optional, so many submissions send nothing
Delivery and template content cannot be proven from the repo

candidates.title: Terms and Conditions notice for fines at warrant stage before payment
candidates.user_story: As URA, I want the payment page to show the Terms and Conditions for compounding offences with warrants of arrest when any selected fine is at warrant stage, so that the offender knows that payment does not cancel the warrant.
acceptance: If any selected notice has last processing stage COW, CWW, CWM, CTW or CWT, Proceed to Payment opens the warrant version of the payment page
The page shows three numbered terms and the sentence 'By proceeding with payment, I acknowledge the above terms and conditions.'
Other fines open the normal payment page without the terms

evidence.what: warrantStages check, calls process.InitPaymentWarrant()
InitPaymentWarrant renders summary, table and InfoWarrant
InfoWarrant terms text; the acknowledgement checkbox call at :201 is commented out

candidates.works_basis: The terms are displayed, but the checkbox that was meant to force acknowledgement is commented out, so the Pay button is active without any acknowledgement.
candidates.ura_requested: no (no flow deck exists in repo)
candidates.points_basis: Estimate. Static text plus a stage check, like OCMS50.12 (1) to OCMS50.20 (2). MGG/URA decision.
demo_steps: In UAT find a vehicle or ID with a notice at COW/CWW stage
Select it on Check and Pay and click Proceed to Payment, see the terms
risks: The OCMS49.2 and OCMS49.5 traces (Clearance Slip, Built - Has gap) already cite this text as partial evidence, so it may be counted twice
Acknowledgement gate is switched off in code
Wording is legal text; no source in repo shows URA approved it

notes: Of 27 seeds, only 5 survive as candidates (3 extension, 2 new: WOGAA and warrant terms). Most seeds were already covered by an existing story or already used as evidence in a Fully paid/Demo paid trace. All candidates are small (2-3 points, total 13) and weak: none was requested by URA in a story, and the strongest evidence are tickets that were handled as defects. Properties were read only for turnstile (dev/uat/prod enabled=true) and mail host; real server values cannot be verified. I read only part of the furnish submit path, so the claim that self-furnish is not re-checked at submit is not fully searched.
